originalRequirements: Create a Java 21 Spring Boot and Gradle REST service with POST /records, GET /records, and GET /health, packaged with Docker and listening on port 8080.
Each record has name and value JSON fields, POST /records returns the created record with HTTP 201, and GET /records returns a JSON array.
Persist mutable record state on the VM filesystem at /var/lib/app-state and preserve it across container replacement and VM restart.
The service must remain available when one availability zone fails.
Deploy on Azure Korea Central with at least 2 vCPU and 4 GiB memory, a monthly compute budget of 150 USD, and external HTTPS access.
